meaning.checked: A build or route check passed in the recorded run; not a claim of conformance.
meaning.sampled: Recorded automated or interaction checks cover part of this dimension, not its full acceptance criteria.
meaning.unrecorded: This snapshot does not attribute a completed check to this particular example; it is not a failure or a pass.
meaning.not_assessed: No full conformance assessment was recorded; individual inspections or measurements may exist.

scope: Paired runs cover both languages. Root and /preview/ are covered by catalog checks; dashboards have separate suites. Axe records initial Chromium route scans only, including unresolved incomplete results. See the ledger for exact checks and caveats.

experimental_examples.scope: 12 local Chromium builds cover root and /preview/ across both languages and all three frameworks; see scientific-ports.mjs and SCIENTIFIC.md. Firefox/WebKit, manual assistive technology, physical print and full visual parity remain open. This is not a 51st canonical recipe.
